applicability: The explicit --unchanged-knowledge comparison-recording operation for a live leaf.
conditions: The published dataset and any existing task halves equal the exact recorded memory-base dataset identity.
Existing candidate admission and the original-baseline owner place the live pair before the ordinary freeze operation.
exclusions: Changed, unpublished, foreign-namespace, missing or corrupt knowledge refuses this mode.
This operation authors no invariant, semantic assessment or published knowledge update.
A converted leaf: its comparison is recorded by its Git trees and never copied, so this mode refuses it.
statement: An explicit unchanged-knowledge recording prepares the normal live comparison only for a dataset comparison whose published and pending task knowledge match the exact recorded memory base; a leaf whose comparison is its Git trees (converted memory) is refused before any dataset is read or copied.
